name: Dale Strong
bio: a Representative from Alabama; born in Huntsville, Madison County, Ala., May 8, 1970; graduated from Sparkman High School, Harvest, Ala., 1988; B.S., Athens State University, Athens, Ala., 1992;  sales representative; emergency medical technician; emergency 9-1-1 dispatcher; firefighter; member of the Madison County, Ala., commission, 1996-2022, chairman, 2012-2022; elected as a Republican to the One Hundred Eighteenth Congress and to the succeeding Congress (January 3, 2023-present).
